sehemu: Part II: Members of Parliament, Constituencies and Election of Members
jina: Procedure for election of Members representing constituencies
maudhui: (1) Members of Parliament representing constituencies shall be elected by the people in accordance with this Constitution and the provisions of a law enacted by Parliament pursuant to this Constitution governing the election of Members representing constituencies. (2) Except where the Electoral Commission directs otherwise in accordance with this Constitution or a law enacted by Parliament for that purpose, only one Member shall be elected in a constituency. (3) Candidates for election in a constituency shall be required to satisfy the following conditions: (a) each shall have been nominated by a political party participating in the election in that constituency; and (b) they shall have submitted their names to the Electoral Commission in accordance with the procedure prescribed by a law enacted by Parliament or specified by the Electoral Commission pursuant to law.
